name: EXSIMHB
recent: Exsim Hospitality 近期动作频繁：拟以 2.26 亿令吉向关联方收购 Empire City 酒店物业（已签有条件认购期权），并有多笔凭单转换新股上市。大股东 Exsim Hospitality Holdings 及 Lim Aik Fu 于 11 月 19 日各减持 2,300 万股。
notable: 与关联方 Iconic Insight 签订有条件认购期权，拟以 2.26 亿令吉收购 Empire City 一栋 32 层、456 间客房的酒店物业。
集资最多约 1.254 亿令吉作营运资金，并已向 Bursa Securities 提交额外上市申请。
大股东 Exsim Hospitality Holdings 及 Lim Aik Fu 于 11 月 19 日各减持 2,300 万股，间接持股降至 67.115%。
risks: 私下配售新股将导致现有股东持股被摊薄。
拟收购的酒店物业属关联方交易，且为尚未建成的物业，交易需满足认购期权及买卖协议条件。
大股东及主要股东在近期减持股份。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收 1.0106 亿令吉，环比增 35.9%，同比增 46.3%；净利 1,255.9 万令吉，环比增 8.4%，同比增 13.5%；净利率 12.4%，低于上一季度的 15.6%。

recent_en: Exsim Hospitality has been active: it has entered into a conditional call option to acquire the Empire City hotel property from a related party for RM226 million, proposed a private placement of new shares to raise up to RM125.4 million for working capital, and completed several warrant conversion listings. Major shareholder Exsim Hospitality Holdings and Lim Aik Fu each disposed of 23 million shares on 19 November.
notable_en: Entered into a conditional call option with related party Iconic Insight to acquire a 32-storey, 456-room hotel property in Empire City for RM226 million.
Proposed a private placement of new shares to raise up to approximately RM125.4 million for working capital, with an additional listing application submitted to Bursa Securities.
Major shareholder Exsim Hospitality Holdings and Lim Aik Fu each disposed of 23 million shares on 19 November, with indirect stake falling to 67.115%.
risks_en: The private placement of new shares will dilute existing shareholders' stakes.
The proposed hotel property acquisition is a related party transaction involving a property yet to be constructed, and is subject to the call option and sale and purchase agreement conditions.
Major and substantial shareholders have recently reduced their shareholdings.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM101.06 million, up 35.9% QoQ and 46.3% YoY; net profit was RM12.559 million, up 8.4% QoQ and 13.5% YoY; net margin was 12.4%, down from 15.6% in the previous quarter.
